description: Return the full schema tree from the desktop app, with live-event statuses merged in, plus the current `revision` (pass it as expectedRevision on writes to detect stale reads). Pass omitNotes: true for polling (large roadmaps exceed the tool-result limit): it leaves out notes and the createdAt/updatedAt timestamps; fetch notes with getNode/findNodes. Requires the app to be running and a file to be loaded.
name: getRoadmap
title: Get the loaded RoadRaven roadmap
